# Quzar — AI & Full-Stack Product Studio

Canonical site: https://quzar.in
Founder: Piyush Ratan (https://piyushratan.in)
Chatbot Platform: https://darpan.quzar.in (Darpan360)
Contact: hello@quzar.in

## Summary

Quzar is an AI and full-stack product studio founded by Piyush Ratan. Quzar builds AI-powered MVPs, Chatbot-as-a-Service systems (Darpan360), RAG pipelines, institutional portals, and high-performance web applications.

## Core Services

- AI-Powered MVPs & Custom LLM/RAG Pipelines
- Managed AI Chatbots & Lead Automation (Darpan360)
- Full-Stack Web Applications (Next.js, React, Node.js, Python, Firebase)
- Technical SEO & Scalable Cloud Architecture

## Featured Shipped Products & Client Systems

- Darpan360 (https://darpan.quzar.in) — Managed Chatbot-as-a-Service platform with domain authorization, custom business personas, and embeddable web widgets.
- Orlin AI (https://orlin-ai.web.app) — AI automation agency platform for real estate lead qualification and onboarding.
- SDRP Inter College (https://sdrpintercollege.com) — Complete digital campus portal with admissions, academics, and local SEO.
- Vaultera (https://vaultera.in) — Smart hardware & vault product platform.
- JMD Production & Casting (https://jmdagency.in) — High-performance talent & casting hub in Noida.
- PCM Syllabus Tracker (https://pcm-syllabus-tracker-eight.vercel.app) — Spaced-repetition syllabus tracker for JEE & Class 11–12 students.
- NCERTGPT — RAG-based Class 12 textbook study assistant.
- CyberAlert — AI-assisted phishing and scam detector.
